context: ProductCache is read on nearly every request (Get) and written rarely (Set, only on catalog refresh). It previously used a plain sync.Mutex, so concurrent readers serialized behind each other even though none of them mutate state.
explanation: Safe to merge. Switching to sync.RWMutex and using RLock/RUnlock in Get lets concurrent readers proceed in parallel, while Set correctly keeps the exclusive Lock/Unlock to serialize writers against readers and each other. Since reads dominate writes here, this removes unnecessary contention without changing correctness.
